Added sounds to the Simon game

Forgot to add the sound queues for the button presses/flashes and the game over, how now been added, along with a timeout on each new level to allow time for the sounds to play out without overlapping and cutting eachother out.

Simon Game Completed

Have successfully completed the simon game without need for using any of the steps in the course. Added notes regarding the completion in Step 0 - Download the starting files section in the notes.

Bug Fix

Encountered a bug where triggering multiple gameovers without a game restart would stack keypress events onto the document, so added a conditional statement into gameOver where the keypress event is only added if it doesn't already exist.

Game start keypress disable

Added functionality that disables the document level keypress event that would start the game, and then re-enable the event on game over.

Random button selection completed.

Completed the functionality for selecting a random button on game start and level up.

Colour Button Click finished

Added a checker for the button click event when it calls check input to confirm when the user has successfully replicated the pattern for a given level, to go to the next level.

Extra functionality testing

Tested adding an extra conditional to the checkInput function where it does not trigger a game over sequence if the generatedList is strill empty. i.e: the game has not been started.

Simon Game Progress

Restarted Development. Tested the finished product and the expectation was different to the progress I'd made. Have implemented and unit tested the following successfully: gameover functionality, user button press visual functionality (minus audio queues) and to check if a particular button press is correct in accordance to the generated list (if empty, defaults to a game over sequence).

Block press function progress

The function to show which blocks are in the sequence has been created, but shows all the blocks in the sequence at the same time. Will be diverting to the instructions for this challenge here.

Button Press function added

Function that simulates a button press for when the new sequence is to be shown has been created and verified.

Unit Testing

Verified the keypress event is working and that the random number sequence generator is functional via unit testing.

Game Logic continued.

Implemented a random sequence generator based on level, working on the sequence display function now.
